integrity: The classical Gessel Lucas congruence and the five digit residues are credited to prior literature. The new claim is the evaluated all-shift pair count and first/second sharp extremal classification; no independent certification or authorship is implied.
scientific_limitations: This classifies fixed-shift two-index nondivisibility by five with relative normalization by the \(3^r\) eligible first indices. It does not classify higher powers of five, multi-shift patterns, general Apéry-like sequences, or priority over all historical automatic-sequence literature. An older relevant paper was available only at abstract level. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp additive overlap laws for five-nondivisible Apéry indices
